keys.name: OFFSET_CROUCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Low offset crouch, chest turned toward an incoming payload line; both feet own the root.

keys.name: REAR_LOAD
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root sinks left; right shoulder and hand open toward the intercept while payload continues leftward.

keys.name: SUPPORT_BREAK
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Rear-leg punch breaks support and commits the root up-right; payload remains independent and left-moving.

keys.name: ASCEND_REACH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root travels up-right; right arm reaches ahead of chest while opposite leg trails long.

keys.name: APEX_INTERCEPT_PREP
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Near-apex scissor; both hands split around the incoming payload path before contact.

keys.name: PAYLOAD_ACQUIRE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Opposed trajectories meet in air; both hands acquire the payload while root remains unsupported and begins losing horizontal travel.

keys.name: MASS_FOLD
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Combined mass produces an immediate three-cell root drop with only one cell of horizontal travel; payload remains visibly bracketed across the chest and no support or second impulse explains the steepening.

keys.name: CARRY_COUNTERSWEEP
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Payload is swept across the chest toward the left hip as the body descends almost vertically; trailing leg counterbalances and the root has effectively spent its horizontal flight.

keys.name: ONE_ARM_TRANSFER_PRECONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Right arm clamps payload to ribs while left forearm and knee aim for a diagonal side-skid landing; root still descends.

keys.name: FOREARM_KNEE_CONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Left forearm and knee hit together on a diagonal; payload remains clamped right while root carries forward into the skid.

keys.name: SIDE_SKID_CRUSH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root slides forward while shoulder and payload lag high-right; left side absorbs and smears the remaining momentum.

keys.name: HAND_FOOT_RESTACK_BRIDGE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Skid converts into a hand-foot bridge; right foot catches the root while payload stays on the task side.

keys.name: CARRY_RISE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Left hand releases support; right foot raises the root while payload keeps the torso laterally biased.

keys.name: DISPLACED_LOADED_SETTLE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Settles far downrange with payload still off-center and shoulder skew retained; no idle reset and no custody drop.

compile.bridge_rule: smoothstep geometry only; payload custody/contact/support remain source-key semantic state until the next decisive authored key

tango_rounds.defect: the payload/catch causal event under-reads: the one-character payload visually merges with the reaching hand and K4 already overlaps the task line, so the central mass-acquisition idea can look like an ordinary pose change
tango_rounds.correction: on the SAME 027 body, separate the incoming payload from both hands at K4, render it as a three-character abstract mass marker, author K5 with the two hands visibly bracketing that mass and hold K5 on TWOS, then make K6 pay the acquisition immediately with a three-cell downward root drop and only one cell of horizontal travel while support stays NONE

tango_rounds.finding: the incoming <#> mass now remains visually separate through K4, K5 clearly brackets it with both hands on a held acquisition beat, K6 immediately steepens the root drop with almost no horizontal gain, K7 carries that debt into a near-vertical descent, and the K9→K10 forearm-knee skid preserves right-arm payload custody instead of reading as an ordinary landing

noodle_queen.taste: opposed-flight intercept → abrupt payload fold → crooked one-arm carry → forearm-knee side skid is a specific silhouette sequence, not a generic jump with a prop
noodle_queen.function: load → support break → diagonal rise → separated precontact → two-hand midair acquisition → combined-mass descent steepening → one-arm prelanding transfer → diagonal forearm+knee catch → skid compression → authored hand-foot restack → loaded rise → displaced settle remains causally legible
noodle_queen.contempt: the payload changes the body instead of decorating it; contact does not grant magical air support; the free arm is sacrificed to landing support; custody survives compression; recovery keeps lateral/task debt and never reverse-interpolates to idle
